alternatives_rejected.reason: Rejected: Develop payload is proposal/step/content/economy-specific; developStaffId_ is a clone-vector index; Staff.state=12 caller and exact form/native entry are not fully reproducible; Develop suppresses ordinary living detours and has separate HP/interruption rules.

Rejected: Planning is a player-wide preparatory phase with parameterless StartPlanning and every-room Staff participation; it has no arbitrary task identity and external progress is not planningRate/planQuality.

product_rationale: An arbitrary external task needs truthful external IDs and lifecycle state without inventing original proposal/content IDs or driving Staff like a puppet. The overlay preserves I0 autonomous office life and keeps product truth separate.

behavioral_consequences.assigned: I0 baseline living; no StartPlanning/STATE_DEVELOP/GotoDesk call
behavioral_consequences.running: product RUNNING plus whatever I0 living state is observed
behavioral_consequences.terminal: product terminal; baseline living remains and no Staff/desk/HP mutation occurs

start_mapping: AssignmentAdapter -> ProductTaskOverlayBridge.enter; no native LivingRuntime write
completion_mapping: ProductTaskOverlayBridge.exit if active -> terminal TaskRecord; no native result/economy chain
implementation_usability: PASS; no original bridge facade is required for Bridge C
source_limits: Exact original Develop state12 writer caller and full indirect sub-state semantics remain documented but are not claimed as product semantics.
